## Problem and change

What question does this address? Which branch and documents are affected?

## Evidence level

Proposed / synthetic / physical bench / biological / clinical. State the actual level and avoid implying a higher one.

## Verification

Commands, references, calibration or raw-data records used; outcomes and limitations.

## Provenance and permissions

Identify original, third-party and generated material. Do not include private or employer-confidential data.

## Checklist

- [ ] Claims match the evidence and uncertainty is described.
- [ ] Relevant links and navigation are updated.
- [ ] Failed or inconclusive findings are preserved where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets or identifiable patient data are included.
